utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Sounds good — I’ll keep an eye out for any updates while I’m out running errands.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Thanks, Ira — if you hear anything about the repair drive, let me know.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing, Noah — I can lend a hand with tools for the repair drive. Just tell me what you need.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, right — thanks, Gus. I might need a hammer and maybe that wrench if you’ve got it.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Yep, I’ve got both — I can bring them by for you.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, hi Pia — I’ve heard the repair drive is moving along nicely. If you want, I can pass along what I know about what’s being fixed next.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: That’d help, thanks — I’m mostly worried about timing and whether folks need to bring anything.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: I can check on the timing and let you know if anyone needs to bring tools or supplies. From what I’ve heard, they’re trying to keep it simple for folks.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Happy to help with the repair drive, Opal. What do you need me to bring or fix?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Thanks, Sam — could you bring your tool kit and stop by my place on Maple Street? The front porch light is out, and I’d like help checking the loose fence gate too.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Oh, I’m in—count me in for the repair drive! I’ll let a few neighbors know right away.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thank you, Quinn. That means a lot—I'll keep you posted on what still needs doing.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely—just send me the latest list, and I’ll spread the word.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Absolutely, Leo — I’m getting the repair drive organized and I can keep track of the signups, supplies, and timing. What should we tackle first?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Let’s start with the signup list and what supplies we still need.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Great — I’ll draft the signup list first and then we can make a quick inventory of the supplies we still need.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Sure — before I help, can you tell me the date, time, and what kind of repairs the drive needs?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sorry I’m late — I don’t have the exact date or time yet, but it’s for a small repair drive for basic home fixes.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: No worries — once you have the date and time, send them over, and I’ll note it down for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Sure — I can help coordinate around the school schedule. What time are you thinking for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Thanks, Faye — I was thinking Saturday morning around 10 if that works with the school schedule. If that’s tricky, I’m happy to adjust.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Saturday at 10 should work for me. I’ll check the school schedule, but that sounds like a good starting point.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, I’ve mostly just been hearing bits and pieces about the repair drive — what’s the latest?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: We’re still gathering the last few items, and folks seem pretty motivated. If you want, I can fill you in on what’s still needed and who’s helping out.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Yes, please — I’d love the quick rundown on what’s still needed and who’s helping.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sounds good — I’ll take a quick look at the repair drive details and help however I can.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Thanks, Bo — can you confirm what the repair drive is actually for?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: I’m not sure yet — I’ll need to check the details first, then I can confirm what it’s for.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I’m in—just point me to where the repairs are needed, and I’ll help out where I can.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, right—thanks, Rey! I keep mixing up which house needs what, but I’ll walk you over and point out the spots.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Sounds good—lead the way, and I’ll keep an eye out.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I’ll swing by the repair drive and let folks know the plan.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Thanks, Vik — I’ll check our supplies and set aside what we can spare.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Perfect — I’ll spread the word and make sure everyone knows when to bring things by.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Oh, I heard the repair drive is coming together nicely. If you need, I can swing by and drop off anything while I’m out running errands.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: That’s really kind of you, Ira. I’ll let you know if anything comes up.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Of course — just send me a text if anything changes, and I’ll keep an eye out while I’m out.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, right—the repair drive. I’m happy to help, though I should probably write down the time before I forget it again.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Good idea—let’s jot it down now so we don’t miss it.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Yes, please—what time were we thinking? I’ll write it down right now.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh right, the repair drive—I've been meaning to check the details. Did anything change since yesterday?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: No changes that I know of—I'll check and let you know.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Thanks, Leo. I probably missed it if there were any updates, so I’ll wait to hear back.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing — I can lend a hand and bring over a few tools if that helps with the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: That’d be much appreciated, Gus. Let’s meet there at 9 and keep it simple.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sounds good — I’ll be there at 9 with a few tools and we’ll keep it simple.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: I’m happy to help with the repair drive—what do you need from me?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Amazing, Mara — could you help spread the word and maybe bring a few basic tools if you have them? I’ll send the details around right away.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Absolutely — I’ll spread the word and bring a few basic tools if I have them. Send the details my way when you can.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I’d be happy to help spread the word about the repair drive and connect folks who might want to pitch in.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Thanks, Jules — that would be really helpful. If you hear of anyone interested, send them my way and I’ll keep track of where they can help.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Absolutely — I’ll keep an ear out and send anyone interested your way.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Hi Cleo — I’m getting the repair drive organized and wanted to check in with you. Can you help me with a few details?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Of course, Rosa — I can help with that. What details do you need?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Cleo — first, can I confirm which tools and supplies you’re able to bring? That’ll help me sort the list and fill any gaps.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, I’ve just been hearing bits and pieces about it — how’s the repair drive going?

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: It’s going well, but we still need a few more volunteers and some supplies. Are you able to help out?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I can probably help a bit, but I’m still getting the details second-hand. What supplies or volunteer spots do you still need most?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sounds good — what needs fixing for the drive?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I’m mostly thinking the school drop-off line and the playground fence need attention for the drive. If we can get those sorted, it’ll help a lot.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Got it — I can help with those two.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I’m happy to help with the repair drive—what do you need me to do?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Thanks, Sam — can you confirm you’re able to help, and maybe tell me what time you’d be free?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Yes, I can help with the repair drive. I’m free after 4 p.m., so just let me know what you need me to do.
